Usage:
  arduino-router [flags]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  version     

Flags:
      --after-ready string    Execute a command after the router is ready)
  -h, --help                  help for arduino-router
  -l, --listen-port string    Listening port for RPC services
  -m, --monitor-port string   Listening port for MCU monitor proxy (default "127.0.0.1:7500")
